Straws On Request – Updated. Commission Chair, James Wang
1.
The Environmental Commission recommends an ordinance that prohibits food-serving establishments from distributing plastic straws unless they are specifically requested by a customer. This ordinance would similar to the attached Davis, CA ordinance, eliding the 17.03.020 Exemption for Fast-Food Service and Take-Out Orders.
